dedupe_keys.name: residential exposure to natural hazards in europe 2000 2020

description: The Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research publishes national residential replacement-cost estimates for 33 European countries during 2000–2020. The dataset contains annual series of gross replacement costs for buildings and household contents per square metre of useful floor area, expressed in nominal and real prices. CSV and Excel files are available publicly through Zenodo under CC-BY-4.0, free to reuse with attribution. A separate readme is listed but was not downloaded. The stated unit is a floor-area cost, not a market price or a monetary loss for an individual disaster. National averages conceal differences between locations, building types and construction quality, which limits direct application to a particular asset. The values can support monetary exposure calculations in flood-damage simulations that distinguish structures from contents. They complement physical building inventories and fractional damage functions by supplying a consistent valuation basis across countries and years.
